dedupe_keys.name: dataset for publication design and characterization of a magnetic loop antenna for partial discharge measurements in gas insulated substations

description: TU Delft researchers publish the spreadsheet accompanying an improved magnetic-loop antenna for partial-discharge measurements in gas-insulated substations. The January 2022 Zenodo release supplies one Excel workbook under CC BY 4.0, free to download, and names the IEEE Sensors Journal paper that describes it. The institutional abstract explains that ferrite beads suppress a mounting-related common-mode resonance, extending the earlier sensor bandwidth. An equivalent electrical circuit is compared with measurements on a one-GHz-bandwidth test bench across the transverse electromagnetic regime. These results can help calibrate sensor and diagnostic-response models within substation simulations. No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this particular experiment. It is distinct from the earlier test-bench study and the later balanced-antenna dataset. Coverage is laboratory characterisation, with no operational monitoring period established. Workbook structure, units, sample spacing, acquisition dates and uncertainty values were not independently checked. The deposit establishes reusable supporting data, but does not identify a separately executable circuit model.
